title: SESSION_CONNECTION_MODEL — concurrent sessions + subscription cap

args.note: P0-2 T2 campaign 2026-07-29; trader-futures+scheduler stopped; WS concurrent sessions + subscription cap

measurements.concurrent_sessions_verdict: accepted 5; ceiling tested was 5. If accepted == max_sessions the cap is ABOVE the tested ceiling — do not record the ceiling as the cap.
measurements.displacement_check: MANUAL: confirm whether opening session N invalidated session N-1 (watch for a server close frame on the earlier connections). A displacing broker means concurrent_sessions is effectively 1.
measurements.subscription_cap_note: config/streaming.yaml:50 asserts 'KIS 제한: 41' as a comment. The draft memo §5:211-216 classes that as unverified. Only this observation may promote or refute it.
measurements.single_symbol_caveat: Subscribing the SAME tr_key repeatedly may be deduplicated by the broker, so this count may understate the cap. Establishing a true cap needs DISTINCT symbols per subscription, which this probe does not yet support (--symbol takes one code). Record the count as a single-symbol observation, not as the subscription limit.

approval_note: This artifact records observations only. Writing any value into VERIFICATION-PROFILE-002.yaml requires a Bounds-Approver; writing any capability status into the Broker Capability Profile INSTANCE requires the P0-2 approval chain (draft memo §8).
